title: hieracium bifidum subsp. conforme
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. conforme, commonly known as Conform Hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family that is native to the mountainous regions of Central and Eastern Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium bifidum subsp. conforme include its ability to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and its potential to stimulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, such as kaempferol and quercetin, as well as phenolic acids and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
